title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Performance Profiler
summary: This blog series documents the evolution of performance profiling tools in Dynamics 365 Business Central across multiple releases, from the snapshot debugger in BC19 through in-client profiling enhancements in BC25-BC27, including features like sampling intervals, profiler schedules, SQL call visibility, and callstack retrieval.
key_points: Multiple profiling capabilities introduced progressively: snapshot debugger (BC19), in-client performance profiler (BC20), sampling intervals (BC23), profiler schedules (BC25), SQL call information (BC27)
Profiler Schedules in BC25 enable easier setup of in-client performance profiling through rules
BC27 adds SQL call information viewing in performance profiles and node copying support in the profile editor
SessionInformation data type in BC26 allows developers to retrieve the current callstack programmatically
